name: target_cover
description: Cover: the best-scoring Guard or Sentinel holder (HP, doubled for Sentinel, plus half a Tidus counter in the two Tidus cases), lowest slot on ties, or the target itself.

harness.note: the real machine code of the function in an x86-32 emulator; battle generator scripted (stream and value recorded); queue inserts and animation requests hooked

notes: out.cover is the slot that covers (the target itself when nobody can).
